task.question: What was the amount released by Shivraj Singh Chouhan for the VB-G RAM-G scheme in July 2026?
task.evidence: 5 July – Union Agriculture and Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan releases the first instalment of ₹25,863 crore (US$2.7 billion) to states for the implementation of the VB-G RAM-G scheme.
